2609.01151.title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
2609.01151.paper_summary: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.
2609.01151.paper_summary_zh: 在標準的LM訓練流程中，子詞標記化作為預處理步驟被應用。子詞段落語言建模是一種替代範式，其中標記化是在訓練過程中學習的，允許模型發現優化其訓練目標的子詞單位。在本文中，我們提出了我們對2026 BabyLM挑戰賽的提交，為此我們開發了兩個新的子詞段落LM：SubSegGPT和SubSegDeBERTa。SubSegGPT是一個僅解碼器模型，在自回歸預訓練過程中學習標記化。SubSegDeBERTa是一個基於編碼器的模型，聯合學習生成和標記化被遮蔽的單詞。我們為Strict和Strict-small賽道訓練了這兩個模型。我們對Strict的最佳提交是SubSegDeBERTa，該模型在零-shot評估中取得了顯著的增益。我們對Strict-small的最佳提交是SubSegGPT，該模型超越了基於標記化的基準。我們的結果顯示，可學習的子詞標記化可以提高BabyLM預訓練的樣本效率。我們分析了模型的子詞學習動態，發現標記化逐漸收斂到平衡形態對齊和細粒度分段的子詞單位。
2609.01151.author: Francois Meyer et.al.
